dedektif.design: American guy in his late twenties, relaxed deep voice, casual and conversational, like a gamer friend telling you a secret on a late night call, natural, not an announcer, slight smile in the voice

lines.text: Okay, why did Rockstar show us this motel?
It's the Starlet Motel, just east of Port Gellhorn.
And players say something weird happens near it. At night.
There's a clearing close by. You go there after dark,
and some people say they've seen a UFO.
The catch? It supposedly only shows up from Chapter Two.
Nobody's fully confirmed it yet. So for now, case unverified.
Have you seen it? Seriously, tell me what happened.
